title: Swap, for real this time
description:
Write `void swapInts(int& a, int& b)` that exchanges the two variables the caller passes in.

Without the `&` the function would swap two private copies and the caller would see nothing. With it, `a` and `b` are other names for the caller's own variables.
hints: The body is already right. Only the parameter list needs to change: two `&` characters.
unitTests:
TEST("swaps the caller's variables") { int x{ 5 }, y{ 9 }; swapInts(x, y); CHECK_EQ(x, 9); CHECK_EQ(y, 5); }
TEST("swapping twice puts them back") { int x{ 1 }, y{ 2 }; swapInts(x, y); swapInts(x, y); CHECK_EQ(x, 1); CHECK_EQ(y, 2); }

grading.unitTests:
TEST("swaps the caller's variables") { int x{ 5 }, y{ 9 }; swapInts(x, y); CHECK_EQ(x, 9); CHECK_EQ(y, 5); }
TEST("swapping twice puts them back") { int x{ 1 }, y{ 2 }; swapInts(x, y); swapInts(x, y); CHECK_EQ(x, 1); CHECK_EQ(y, 2); }
